content:
Priya K.: customer reported 429s around 08:10 UTC, but quota panel shows ~80% remaining for their org. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/9876/quota :eyes:
Sam (support): getting same from support logs — two customers in EU got bursts of 429s between 08:05-08:18. Created ticket RI-4532 and captured request IDs.
Javier L.: pulling enforcement-service metrics now. counters show spikes in `quota_exceeded` at 08:06. Strange: the 'remaining_quota' timeseries on the console tiles is flat during the spike.
Megan (eng-infra): @Javier can you run the consumer-lag query for `quota-events-prod`? suspecting ingestion lag/backlog. try:
```
SELECT max(lag) as max_lag_mins
FROM kafka_consumer_offsets
WHERE topic = 'quota-events-prod' AND consumer_group = 'quota-aggregator'
```
Javier L.: running that now — got output: 
```
max_lag_mins: 45
consumer_group: quota-aggregator
partitions_behind: 34
```
Sam (support): reproduced request from customer: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Headers:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1700000000
```
Priya K.: dashboard tiles show "last updated 08:00" while enforcement logs show events at 08:06-08:18. that's ~15-20m behind — matches the consumer lag.
Megan (eng-infra): found the aggregator pod crashed after last night's deploy; consumer group was left paused. I restarted the service and resumed the consumer. also started a backfill for the missed partitions (infra-job/ri-backfill-1763).
ops-bot: Job infra-job/ri-backfill-1763 started by Megan (eng-infra). ETA ~45m.
Javier L.: after restart, real-time panels began filling. spot-checked org 9876: enforcement counter and UI remaining_quota now align for 08:30 sample. backfill still catching up for 08:00-08:20 window.
Priya K.: told customer we identified ingestion delay and are replaying events; they'll continue to see transient 429s until backfill completes.
Megan (eng-infra): root cause: enforcement-service telemetry changed one label key in v2 (renamed `org_id` -> `organization`). aggregator filter only matched `org_id` and ignored v2 messages, so a bunch of events were routed to the unknown bucket and never counted by the tiles. PR #987 fixes label mapping + adds validation.
Sam (support): noted for the postmortem and PM follow-up. adding RI-4532 to the incident board.
Priya K.: will monitor until infra-job finishes. please post back when backfill complete. :white_check_mark:
Megan (eng-infra): backfill finished at 09:12 UTC. reprocessed ~5.2M events, panels refreshed, customers confirmed no further 429s. root cause and mitigation logged in RI-4532; follow-up: add schema enforcement to telemetry pipeline and alert on consumer lag > 10m.
Priya K.: thanks everyone — closing thread after 1h monitoring window passes.
